title: Smallest Stable Index I
goal: Solve Smallest Stable Index I: Track inclusive suffix minima and prefix maxima to find the first index within the instability threshold.
strategy: Track inclusive suffix minima and prefix maxima to find the first index within the instability threshold.

phasePurposes.suffix: Build minima from right to left.
phasePurposes.check: Update the prefix maximum and compare the instability score with k.
phasePurposes.done: Return the first passing index, or −1 when all fail.

edgeCases: Prefix maxima and suffix minima include the candidate index. A singleton has instability zero; return the first passing index, not the best-scoring index.
